recipes.name: Tactile Button Press (Emil Kowalski Scale-97)
recipes.when_to_use: Primary buttons, secondary action triggers, toolbar buttons, and interactive cards that respond to pointer down.
recipes.tailwind_classes: transition-transform duration-150 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:active:scale-100
forbidden_slop: hover:scale-105 on standard UI buttons (causes layout jitter)

recipes.name: Subtle Modal Enter/Exit (Never From Scale 0)
recipes.when_to_use: Centered dialog modals, confirmation prompts, and command palettes (`cmdk`).
recipes.tailwind_classes: transition-[transform,opacity] duration-180 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] data-[state=closed]:scale-95 data-[state=closed]:opacity-0 data-[state=open]:scale-100 data-[state=open]:opacity-100 motion-reduce:transition-none
forbidden_slop: Animating from scale(0) or scale(0.5) (balloon pop effect)
Exit animation slower than enter animation (exit must be <= 150ms)
Bouncy elastic overshoot on enterprise dialogs

recipes.name: Origin-Aware Dropdown & Popover
recipes.when_to_use: Select menus, context menus, tooltips, user profile popovers, and date pickers anchored to a trigger.
recipes.tailwind_classes: origin-[var(--radix-popover-content-transform-origin)] transition-[transform,opacity] duration-140 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] data-[state=closed]:scale-95 data-[state=closed]:opacity-0 data-[state=open]:scale-100 data-[state=open]:opacity-100 motion-reduce:transition-none
forbidden_slop: Default transform-origin: center on anchored dropdowns (detaches menu from trigger)
Animating height or max-height instead of transform + opacity
Delaying tooltip appearance on subsequent hovers when already warmed up

recipes.name: iOS-Physics Sheet & Drawer Slide
recipes.when_to_use: Side inspection panels, mobile bottom sheets (Vaul style), and filter drawers.
recipes.tailwind_classes: transition-transform duration-280 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)] data-[state=closed]:translate-y-full md:data-[state=closed]:translate-x-full md:data-[state=closed]:translate-y-0 data-[state=open]:translate-x-0 data-[state=open]:translate-y-0 motion-reduce:transition-none
forbidden_slop: Animating right: -400px to right: 0px (triggers main-thread layout thrashing on every frame)
Linear or ease-in-out timing curves on sheets (feels robotic and sluggish)

recipes.name: Sonner-Style Layered Toast Stack
recipes.when_to_use: Non-blocking feedback notifications, undoable mutations, and background job completion alerts.
recipes.tailwind_classes: transition-[transform,opacity] duration-220 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)] translate-y-0 opacity-100 data-[swipe=cancel]:translate-x-0 data-[swipe=end]:translate-x-full motion-reduce:transition-none
forbidden_slop: Stacking 10+ full-height toasts that cover half the viewport
Auto-dismissing error toasts in under 4 seconds before the user can read the recovery action

recipes.name: Zero-CLS Structural Skeleton Shimmer
recipes.when_to_use: Async data loading states for tables, metric cards, and detail panes where exact layout geometry is known.
forbidden_slop: Centered full-page spinning loader when the shell layout can be rendered immediately
Skeleton dimensions that do not match the loaded content height (causes Cumulative Layout Shift)

recipes.name: 60fps GPU Compositor Micro-Transition
recipes.when_to_use: Tab indicators, SegmentedControl active pill highlight, accordion chevrons, and row hover elevation.
forbidden_slop: Animating width, left, top, margin, or padding on tab indicators instead of translate3d/scaleX
